breakdown.description: Case described as inviscid but viscosity set to 1e-5; inviscid flow should use zero viscosity
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The user requested an 'inviscid' simulation but provided a non-zero viscosity (1e-5). The ground truth correctly sets the viscosity to 0 for an inviscid case. The agent's generated specification repeated the user's incorrect value of 'dynamic viscosity = 1e-5' instead of correcting it.
